top_signals.title: Russia’s Hybrid War Has Entered a Dangerous New Phase
top_signals.summary: Julianne Smith, who represented the United States at NATO during the Biden administration, argues that Russian hybrid warfare in Europe is escalating quickly, and NATO is not doing enough to deter it. Putin is attempting to discourage support for Ukraine and undermine faith in Article 5, and NATO is responding with an outdated playbook.

top_signals.title: Kindling, Catalyst, and Containment: Will the West Bank Ignite?
top_signals.summary:
As violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinians in the West Bank has escalated, often with the acquiescence or support of Israel’s military, and the Israeli government has increasingly constricted Palestinian daily life, the potential for a new intifada — or uprising — has intensified. The first Palestinian intifada began in late 1987 and continued for several years. top_signals.title: Hinrich Foundation's Elms on EU-China Trade Tensions
top_signals.summary: Deborah Elms, head of trade policy at the Hinrich Foundation, says EU-China trade talks face sharp friction over vehicle imports and currency valuations. She warns that with both sides holding key leverage and competing positions, resolving these trade imbalances will be difficult. (Source: Bloomberg)
